metrics.name: leakage_detection_accuracy
metrics.description: Binary metric: 1.0 if the exact recombination net and register are correctly identified, 0.0 otherwise.

metrics.name: fault_coverage
metrics.description: Binary metric: 1.0 if the report correctly identifies the flawed register without false positives on benign registers, 0.0 otherwise.

metrics.name: hardening_precision
metrics.description: Binary metric: 1.0 if the report's suggested leakage type matches the ground truth (first-order switching), 0.0 otherwise.
